label: Figure 7.3: The market for e-bikes
alt: Demand for e-bikes shifts right from D to D1 against supply S; at the old price Pe there is excess demand Q2 minus Qe, so price rises to the new equilibrium Pe1.
caption: A rise in incomes shifts demand for e-bikes from D to D<sub>1</sub>. At the old price P<sub>e</sub> quantity demanded jumps to Q<sub>2</sub> while supply is still Q<sub>e</sub>, creating excess demand (Q<sub>2</sub> − Q<sub>e</sub>). Price rises until the new equilibrium (P<sub>e1</sub>, Q<sub>e1</sub>) is reached.
